Server configuration

Server Info

These values are set via CLI arguments and cannot be changed at runtime.

Loading...
Upstream DNS

One server per line — ip:port, tls://host (DoT), or https://host/dns-query (DoH)

Strategy

How upstream servers are selected for each DNS query.

DNSSEC

Surfaces the upstream's DNSSEC verdict (AD flag) per query in the log. This is transparency, not local validation — for end-to-end trustworthy results: use a validating upstream (1.1.1.1 / 9.9.9.9), set the upstream to tls://… so the verdict reaches noadd untampered, and point devices at noadd's DoH endpoint.

Block mode

How blocked queries are answered. Default returns a null IP (0.0.0.0 / ::).

Log Retention
days
Public URL

Used for Apple mobileconfig profiles. Must be HTTPS with a valid domain.

DoH Access Control

Default policy for unauthenticated DoH requests (without a token in URL).

DoH Tokens

Each token becomes a DoH URL path: /dns-query/your-token. Always works regardless of policy.
